about.title: About Me
about.emailPrompt: I'm always keen to hear about potential new projects so please don't hesitate to get in touch.
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Nicolas, a senior web developer crafting modern web products where design meets engineering. My approach is product-first: every line of code serves a business goal.
about.paragraph2: Over the last 5+ years I've built applications that users rely on and businesses depend on, from early-stage startups to enterprise platforms across SaaS, e-commerce, and internal tools.
about.paragraph3: I think like a product builder, not just a coder. I ask "why" before "how", prioritize impact over complexity, and ship with confidence.

lexya.description: Major overhaul of a leading textbook e-commerce platform in Quebec.
lexya.seoDescription: Complete redesign and rebuild of Lexya’s textbook e‑commerce platform in Quebec, focused on performance, UX, and scalable content management.
lexya.longDescription: Close collaboration with MamboMambo agency to transform Lexya's visual identity into a cutting-edge digital experience. Orchestrated the transition to PayloadCMS and Next.js for total editorial flexibility and peak performance.
lexya.impact: Modernized technical architecture, enabling seamless content management and an ultra-fast shopping experience.

achete_ton_cell.description: Hybrid e-commerce ecosystem linking online store and physical retail locations.
achete_ton_cell.seoDescription: Custom Shopify ecosystem connecting online and in‑store sales, optimized for conversion, inventory sync, and retail operations.
achete_ton_cell.longDescription: Developed a custom Shopify solution featuring complex inventory synchronization with in-store POS systems. Focused on mobile conversion and checkout optimization for a highly competitive electronics market.
achete_ton_cell.impact: Unified the customer experience between Web and physical retail, optimized through precise conversion data analysis.

hockey_academie.description: Specialized e-commerce and booking platform for elite sports training.
hockey_academie.seoDescription: Shopify‑based booking and e‑commerce platform for elite training programs, built to simplify reservations and drive visibility.
hockey_academie.longDescription: Designed an optimized Shopify store for product sales and service management. Tailored the user experience to simplify complex bookings while maintaining a clean interface for parents and athletes.
hockey_academie.impact: Automated the booking process and significantly increased visibility for training programs.

chaparral_ev.description: Showcase platform for a Quebec leader in recreational electric vehicles.
chaparral_ev.longDescription: Developed a full-featured WordPress site tailored for lead generation. Focused on information architecture and Organic SEO optimization to establish a strong digital presence in the EV market.
chaparral_ev.impact: Enhanced digital reach and created an intuitive browsing experience for high-end vehicle models.

optimize_id.description: High-performance showcase site for a branding and visual identity agency.
optimize_id.longDescription: Built an agile platform to highlight professional branding and signage services. Focused on page speed and local SEO optimization to drive B2B lead generation.
optimize_id.impact: Established a strong presence in the Quebec market and delivered a simplified management interface for the client.

mleau.description: Technical and SEO enhancements for a water treatment specialist.
mleau.longDescription: Targeted improvements on an existing WordPress site. Optimized the conversion funnel, enhanced mobile navigation, and implemented a technical SEO strategy to boost organic reach.
mleau.impact: Smoother user experience and improved search engine rankings without service interruption.

gamechanger_hockey.description: Full-featured online store specializing in performance hockey equipment.
gamechanger_hockey.longDescription: Built a custom Shopify experience for a hockey accessory brand. Developed custom Liquid sections, optimized the checkout funnel, and implemented advanced inventory and payment management systems.
gamechanger_hockey.impact: Launched a robust sales platform with intuitive navigation, driving conversion and customer loyalty.

espace_beaute_cp.description: Hybrid platform combining a professional product store with an online course academy.
espace_beaute_cp.longDescription: Developed a custom Shopify solution featuring a Learning Management System (LMS) integration. Created custom sections to streamline course access while optimizing the sales funnel for physical products.
espace_beaute_cp.impact: Centralized educational and commercial offerings, simplifying registration management and boosting cross-selling opportunities.

portfolio.impact: Created a clear, conversion‑oriented showcase to communicate expertise, process, and the quality of work.
